Sync conflicts on documents larger than 10MB

maintainer_bot
Since 2.4.0, editing a document larger than 10MB while offline produces merge conflicts on nearly every sync. Steps: open the 20MB sample doc, go offline, make edits in two clients, reconnect. Expected: CRDT merges cleanly. Actual: duplicate sections appear.
contributor_a 14
Reproduced on 2.4.1. Looks like the background segmenter splits large docs differently per client, so the CRDT sees mismatched operation boundaries.
permalink
contributor_b
Confirmed the segmenter theory. Pinning segment size to a fixed 64KB in a local build made the conflicts disappear.
